notes:
FC-01 OPERATOR OVERRIDE corpus, program 3 of 8 (Hangman, BASIC).
ADAPTATION / DOCUMENTED UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE CHANGES (removal/substitution list):
(1) TAB(15)/TAB(42) banner (BASIC 10/20) DROPPED - no counted PUT; EDIT-00 measures
the counted-SKIP refusal.
(2) The 50-word DATA table reduced to THREE declared words GUM, FLY, SLEEPER,
played SEQUENTIALLY (declared RND replacement: none needed; the used-word redraw of
BASIC 20/60 D$(I)=CHR$(0)/RND is dropped with it). ON q>3 prints
'YOU DID ALL THE WORDS!!' and stops - the script's third answer 1 reaches it.
(3) ALL letters are INTEGER ASCII codes: CHARACTER console GET is UNMEASURED, so
INPUT becomes GET LIST of a fixed 23-value numeric script; the two prompts state
the ASCII-code contract explicitly.
(4) Every displayed character routes through the nested show: procedure (c), a
34-branch literal -> character(1)-varying ladder with ONE natural-width PUT LIST
(the measured STRNG-00/WKDAY-00 rev3 shape); a direct character-array PUT is not a
measured shape.
(5) The word-guess interlude (320-360) DROPPED (declared); the 610 half-line quirk
DROPPED; dead 620/990 DROPPED; ON M GOTO and the IF Q=... ON chains became if
ladders.
(6) APOSTROPHE REWRITE (no doubled-quote literal in this port): ISN'T -> IS NOT,
IT'S -> IT IS, LET'S -> LET US, HERE'S/YOU'RE -> HERE IS ... YOU ARE, HASN'T -> IT
HAS BEEN (FUN line rewritten without contractions).
(7) The 12x12 char grid is flattened to p(144) FIXED codes: literal stage-cell
stores verified against the listing and a walking row counter b = b + 1 (NO
division anywhere - variable DIV is MEASURED refused, HAMM-00 rev1).
(8) SEPARATOR LAW ADAPTATION (declared): under the MEASURED leading-blank law (one
blank precedes every PUT LIST item that is not the first since the last line start,
ACROSS statements - witnesses: stored Batch-A PASS captures, DR goldens
golden/e32rt_E32B1 == e32b_E32B1_dr) the dash/letter row, the used-letter row and
every grid row render SPACE-separated; no separator-free route exists (||, SUBSTR/
LENGTH, counted PUT EDIT and multi-item internal-member PUT are all measured
refusals/FAILs - STRCAT-00, BUILTIN-00, EDIT-00, Batch-A). The design hop's
no-separator byte model is FALSIFIED, kept as written (PROTOCOL #2).
(9) m <> 10 (BASIC 590) ported as DIRECT STRICT if m < 10: m <= 10 by construction
(10-rung ladder), so m <> 10 is exactly m < 10; the design hop's shift t1 = m + 1;
t1 < 12 is FALSIFIED (always true in the domain). Weak compares are refused
(COND-00: COND.GE_LE), strict compares only, constants >= 1.
(10) goto never crosses an ACTIVE DO: the DUP and dash checks set flag vars du/dsh
and goto from flat context; u(nu) is a DENSE 26-cell store replacing the BASIC
first-empty-slot scan (same visible outcome).
(11) Framing/echo laws: three leading bare PUT SKIPs give the three leading blank
lines [C352]; the consumed GET echo line carries its trailing CR; a consumed GET
CLOSES the line, so FOUND/DUP/ALLEXT and the header print DIRECTLY after echoes;
BASIC 400 (PRINT:PRINT:PRINT msg) = exactly TWO blanks before SORRY; ALLEXT prints
with NO trailing skip and the exit CRLF [C352] closes it - the stream ENDS at
'YOU DID ALL THE WORDS!!' (no trailing blank); the cw=0 FUN path is compile-only
(the script never answers 0). 329 normalized lines; 23 GET values, all <= 90.
(12) FIRST lane-B RUN of numeric GET with echo, of the nested show procedure
PUTting its own varying cell, of nested DO x2 rendering, of goto-in-IF and of the
10-rung stage ladder at RUN time (COMPILE-witnessed in ignored scratch shapes01/
shapes02, lane-B RUN unwitnessed); expected stream derived from the declared design
via reference.py:hang00, never captured (L3); a FAIL stays classified, never
laundered.
